blocks.text: Phishing ek scam (dhoka) hai jis mein koi shakhs kisi trustworthy (bharose wali) organization (idara, jaise bank) ka roop bana kar aap ko dhoka deta hai ta ke aap apni personal maloomat de dein.

Misal: Aap ko aisi email aa sakti hai jo dekhne mein aap ke bank ki lagti hai aur kehti hai ke link par click karein aur apne account ki details likhein. Agar aap aisa karein to aap ke paise khatre mein par sakte hain, kyunke woh email jaali (fake) hai.

blocks.prompt: Do nishaniyan bataiye jin se lage ke email phishing ho sakti hai.
blocks.explanation: Email jaldi jaldi password ya account details maangti hai; aur us ka link ya bhejne wale ka address asal organization (jaise bank) ke address se mel nahi khata.

items: Phishing: bharose wali organization ban kar (jaise bank ki jaali email) personal maloomat churana.
